product.ta-10-3.summary: The TA 10/3 loaded programs from an endless magnetic tape.
product.ta-10-3.history: This accounting model built the magnetic drive into the desk and retained the TA 10/2 numeric keypad.
product.ta-10-3.technical.configuration: The interchangeable tape let operators change tasks. The manual distinguishes the program cassette from the built-in magnetic drive.
product.ta-10-3.technical.verified: BluMach has no runnable profile for this model.
product.ta-10-3.technical.limitations: The program from an identified unit and an operating test remain pending.
